added: Private-safe HTTP 429 diagnostics identifying whether the failure occurred in the chapter list, image URL lookup, or image transfer.
Respect numeric Retry-After information supplied by the source, when available, rather than always guessing a long cooldown.
fixed: Avoid hiding the stage where a source rejects a page, and avoid longer arbitrary backoff when the source explicitly permits an earlier retry.
improved: Preserve existing one-chapter-at-a-time download behavior, saved partial pages, network constraints and WorkManager automatic continuation.
Retain the existing HttpException constructor for binary compatibility with installed extensions.
